q.t: 1 minute = how many seconds?
q.e: Each minute is cut into 60 seconds.

q.t: 1 hour = how many minutes?
q.e: Each hour is cut into 60 minutes.

q.t: 2 hours = how many minutes?
q.e: Big unit to small unit: multiply by 60.

q.t: 1 hr 10 min = how many minutes?
q.e: 1 hour = 60 minutes, plus 10.

q.t: Write 02:30 p.m. in 24-hour time.
q.e: p.m. means after midday, so add 12 hours: 2 + 12 = 14.

q.t: Race times: Akira 1 min 55 sec, Sunita 1 min 56 sec, Mary 1 min 57 sec. Who won?
q.e: The winner takes the LEAST time. Only the seconds tell them apart.

q.t: Blinking your eyes takes about one:
q.e: You finish a blink long before you could count to 60.

q.t: How many hours from 09:15 a.m. to 11:15 a.m.?
q.e: The minutes match, so only whole hours have passed.

q.t: 12 midnight in 24-hour time is:
q.e: At midnight the new day has just started, so zero hours of it have passed.

q.t: 75 minutes = ?
q.e: 60 minutes make 1 hour, and 75 − 60 = 15 minutes are left.

q.t: 3 hr 15 min = how many minutes?
10 min 13 sec = how many seconds?
320 seconds = ?
q.e: 5 × 60 = 300, and 320 − 300 = 20 seconds left.

q.t: 20:45 in 12-hour time is:
q.e: Any hour of 13 or more is p.m.: take away 12, so 20 − 12 = 8.

q.t: How long is it from 09:15 a.m. to 11:30 a.m.?
q.e: Count on: 45 min to 10:00, 1 hr to 11:00, 30 min to 11:30. 45 + 30 = 75 min = 1 hr 15 min, plus 1 hr.

q.t: How many minutes from 01:15 p.m. to 01:42 p.m.?
q.e: The hour is the same, so just subtract the minutes.

q.t: How many hours from 03:18 p.m. to 08:18 p.m.?
q.e: The minutes match, so exactly whole hours have passed.

q.t: A third of an hour = how many minutes?
q.e: 60 shares into 3 equal parts of 20 — one reason we use 60.

q.t: 17:30 in 12-hour time is:
q.e: 17 − 12 = 5, and it is after midday, so p.m.

q.t: 12 noon in 24-hour time is:
q.e: At noon 12 hours of the day have passed, so it stays 12:00.

q.t: 220 minutes = ?
q.e: 220 ÷ 60 = 3 remainder 40: 3 hours and 40 minutes left over.

q.t: Jyoti leaves at 06:15 p.m. and travels for 1 hr 45 min. When does she arrive?
q.e: Add the hour first: 07:15. Then 45 minutes more reaches 08:00.

q.t: Ragini finishes at 09:40 p.m. after working for 1 hr 10 min. When did she start?
q.e: Count back: 1 hour to 08:40, then 10 minutes to 08:30.

q.t: Raghav studies 4 subjects for 50 minutes each. How many minutes is that?
q.e: 4 × 50 = 200 minutes (which is 3 hr 20 min).

q.t: 1,000 seconds = ?
How long is it from 09:45 to 11:30 (same morning)?
q.e: Count on: 15 min to 10:00, 1 hr to 11:00, 30 min more. 15 + 30 = 45 min, plus 1 hr.

q.t: Why does an hour have 60 minutes and not 100?
o: 60 splits into halves, thirds, quarters, fifths and sixths as whole numbers
q.e: A third of 100 is not a whole number, but a third of 60 is 20.

q.t: 12:30 a.m. in 24-hour time is:
q.e: It is 30 minutes after midnight, and midnight is 00:00.

q.t: A picnic bus leaves at 08:30 a.m. and returns after 4 hr 10 min. When does it return?
q.e: 08:30 + 4 hr = 12:30, + 10 min = 12:40. It crossed noon, so it is p.m.

q.t: A fifth of an hour = how many minutes?
A train leaves at 20:35 and the journey takes 8 hr 25 min. When does it arrive?
q.e: 20:35 + 8 hr = 28:35; take away 24 for the new day → 04:35. Add 25 min → 05:00.

q.t: A film of 2 hr 35 min starts at 6:50 p.m. When does it end?
q.e: 6:50 + 2 hr = 8:50. Then 10 min to 9:00 and 25 min more: 9:25.

q.t: Race times: 2 min 05 sec, 1 min 58 sec, 2 min 01 sec. How many seconds faster was the winner than the slowest runner?
q.e: In seconds: 125, 118 and 121. Fastest 118, slowest 125: 125 − 118 = 7.

q.t: A bus leaves at 07:45 and arrives at 13:20. How many minutes is the journey?
q.e: Count on: 15 min to 08:00, 5 hr to 13:00, 20 min more = 5 hr 35 min = 335 min.

q.t: School starts at 9:00 a.m. with 5 lessons of 40 min and 2 breaks of 15 min. When does it end?
Someone works out 11:30 − 09:45 in columns and gets 1:85. What went wrong?
o: An hour has 60 minutes, not 100, so 1:85 cannot be a time
q.e: Minutes borrow 60 from the hours, not 10 or 100. Counting on gives 1 hr 45 min.

q.t: Meena sleeps from 9:30 p.m. to 6:15 a.m. How many minutes does she sleep?
q.e: Count on: 30 min to 10:00 p.m., 8 hr to 6:00 a.m., 15 min more = 8 hr 45 min = 525 min.

q.t: How many seconds are there in 1 hour?
q.e: 60 minutes, each of 60 seconds: 60 × 60.

q.t: A flight takes off at 23:50 and lands at 02:10 the next day. How many minutes is the flight?
q.e: 10 min to midnight (00:00), 2 hr to 02:00, 10 min more: 140 min.

q.t: Ravi runs one round of 400 m in 1 min 20 sec. How many seconds for 3 rounds at the same speed?
q.e: 1 min 20 sec = 80 sec, and 3 × 80 = 240 sec (4 minutes).
